title: HIV Treatment Adherence Dose Determination Trial
official: DOSE DETERMINATION TRIAL: The Start/Persist Studies
summary: The proposed research will conduct the first dose-determination trial to find the optimal number of behavioral counseling sessions (dose) needed to achieve and sustain optimal HIV treatment adherence. The results of this study will determine how much intervention is needed for whom and at what cost to guide health policy and implementation of behavioral interventions designed to improve durable viral suppression.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed HIV positive
* Confirmed prescribed antiretroviral therapy
* Confirmed non-adherent to anti-retroviral therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not have access to a phone
* Does not have access to the internet
